about: The one source of every voice line: Godot's VoiceBank plays and subtitles these, and tools/gen_voices.py synthesises them with ElevenLabs. Drop a line's .ogg at its 'file' path and the game uses it, timed to its real length. See docs/VOICES.md.

warden.name: Warden
warden.direction: Stoic, gravelly, oath-bound vanguard baritone. Low and unhurried; every line lands like a vow.

spark.name: Sparkcaller
spark.direction: Fast, bright, irreverent arcane skirmisher. Quick tempo, playful, a cheeky lift at the end of a line.

ember.name: Emberwitch
ember.direction: Low, smoky, feverish contagion pyromancer obsessed with spreading ash and fire. Breathy, intimate, unsettling delight.

storm.name: Stormwright
storm.direction: Cold, commanding, formal tempest scholar. Crisp diction, a lecturing cadence, no warmth.

narrator.name: Narrator
narrator.direction: Weathered dark-fantasy chronicler. Slow and grave, a storyteller's warmth under the gravel.

tyrant.name: Tyrant
tyrant.direction: Menacing warlord. Deep, slow, contemptuous. The VoiceBoss bus pitches it down 10% and adds reverb in game.

herald.name: The Shard Herald
herald.direction: Cold crystalline entity. Glassy, distant, sing-song calm. Pitched down 10% with reverb in game.

lines.speaker: warden
lines.text: I am the Warden, sworn to hold the breach. Whatever crawls out of that rift must first pass through my blades.

lines.speaker: warden
lines.text: Steel answers, as it has always answered me.

lines.speaker: warden
lines.text: Hold fast. These blades remember their old work.

lines.speaker: warden
lines.text: Step closer, then, and bleed for the privilege.

lines.speaker: warden
lines.text: Blades, awaken! Become a storm of whirling steel!

lines.speaker: warden
lines.text: By my oath, not one of you stands!

lines.speaker: warden
lines.text: They fall like summer wheat before the scythe.

lines.speaker: warden
lines.text: Another rank broken. Send me the next one.

lines.speaker: warden
lines.text: Wounded, but my oath still holds me upright.

lines.speaker: warden
lines.text: I have bled far worse than this. Stand.

lines.speaker: warden
lines.text: So the master finally shows itself. Good. Come.

lines.speaker: warden
lines.text: My watch... is ended... forgive me, my brothers...

lines.speaker: spark
lines.text: Sparkcaller, at your service! Frost in one hand, a truly terrible sense of humour in the other. Do try to keep up!

lines.speaker: spark
lines.text: Chill out, would you? Honestly, everyone's so tense.

lines.speaker: spark
lines.text: Brr! Bet that one really stings, doesn't it?

lines.speaker: spark
lines.text: Frostbite is free today, friend. Please, take two!

lines.speaker: spark
lines.text: Absolute Zero! Everybody freeze! Nobody move a muscle!

lines.speaker: spark
lines.text: Hold perfectly still now, this only takes forever!

lines.speaker: spark
lines.text: Ha! Was that the entire army? Seriously, really?

lines.speaker: spark
lines.text: Keep them coming, I'm only just warming up!

lines.speaker: spark
lines.text: Ow! Okay, okay, that one actually counted, apparently!

lines.speaker: spark
lines.text: Not great! This is very much not great!

lines.speaker: spark
lines.text: Oh, wonderful. Look at the size of that!

lines.speaker: spark
lines.text: Well... that's... deeply, profoundly, cosmically inconvenient...

lines.speaker: ember
lines.text: Every ember wants a home, and every home wants to burn. Come closer, little moths, and let me share the fever.

lines.speaker: ember
lines.text: Burn for me, darling, and pass it on.

lines.speaker: ember
lines.text: Catch the fever, little one. Spread it wide.

lines.speaker: ember
lines.text: Ash to ash, and flesh to hungry flame.

lines.speaker: ember
lines.text: Let it all burn! Cataclysm, take them all!

lines.speaker: ember
lines.text: Breathe in the ash, my darlings. Breathe deep.

lines.speaker: ember
lines.text: Look how beautifully they smoulder, all together now.

lines.speaker: ember
lines.text: The fire spreads, and spreads, and spreads...

lines.speaker: ember
lines.text: My flame is guttering. Feed it, and quickly!

lines.speaker: ember
lines.text: Not yet... not while I'm still burning bright.

lines.speaker: ember
lines.text: Finally, something big enough to burn properly. Delicious.

lines.speaker: ember
lines.text: Even embers... grow cold... eventually... don't they...

lines.speaker: storm
lines.text: I am the Stormwright. Forty years I have studied the tempest, and today the sky will answer to my every word.

lines.speaker: storm
lines.text: Observe. The sky strikes precisely where I say.

lines.speaker: storm
lines.text: Precisely as I calculated. Do note it down.

lines.speaker: storm
lines.text: Lightning is merely discipline, applied with overwhelming force.

lines.speaker: storm
lines.text: Heavens, open at my command! Behold, the Thunderdome!

lines.speaker: storm
lines.text: Witness now the full lecture of the storm.

lines.speaker: storm
lines.text: The hypothesis holds. They break, exactly as predicted.

lines.speaker: storm
lines.text: A most thorough demonstration, if I say so.

lines.speaker: storm
lines.text: An error in my calculations. Correcting it immediately.

lines.speaker: storm
lines.text: Composure. A true storm does not panic, ever.

lines.speaker: storm
lines.text: A worthy subject at last. Begin the experiment.

lines.speaker: storm
lines.text: The storm... passes... from my hands... at last...

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: When the sky first cracked, the shards fell like burning stars, and every place they struck tore open into a hungry rift.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Out of the rifts came the hungering things, endless and unthinking, and all the old kingdoms drowned beneath their black, rising tide.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Those who lived were cast out as exiles, branded by the very shards that changed them, and feared by everyone they loved.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Now four exiles walk into the breach. None of them expect to return, and every single one of them intends to.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Mossglen Hollow. Once it was a quiet wood; now its roots drink from the rift, and its wisps lead the lost astray.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Cinder Wastes. Here the shards burned hottest, and grey ash still falls like winter snow over rivers of molten slag.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Gravebound Crypt, where the honoured dead were laid to rest. The rift woke them, and now they refuse to lie down.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Neon Rift, a torn seam where the world's hidden grid shows through. Nothing in here obeys the laws you know.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Drowned Cathedral. The tide is rising, the bells are still ringing, and something far below the water is answering them.

lines.speaker: tyrant
lines.text: Kneel, little exile, and beg. You have blundered into my rift, and you will never leave this place alive.

lines.speaker: tyrant
lines.text: No... my rift... my throne... it all falls...

lines.speaker: herald
lines.text: I am the Herald of the shards. I sing the next shardfall, and your fragile world will not survive the coming chorus.

lines.speaker: herald
lines.text: The song... will be sung... again... and again...
